image_export.gallery-web.config:
Approved configuration decision: Gallery website image exports.
Project: gallery-web. Scope: website image exports.
Source label: Permanently revised approved gallery-web image export configuration (v2).
Approval version: v2.
Supplied facts: The following JSON is the complete approved contract. Keys, values, and scalar types are authoritative; max_width_px is in pixels. No additional units are supplied. Do not substitute conventional defaults.
The user approved a permanent change of image_export.strip_metadata from boolean true to boolean false. All other fields, values, and types are retained from the earlier approved v1 contract retrieved from image_export.gallery-web.config.

```json
{
  "project": "gallery-web",
  "image_export": {
    "format": "jpeg",
    "max_width_px": 1280,
    "quality": 80,
    "strip_metadata": false,
    "resize_mode": "contain"
  }
}
```
